tools.name: sieve_selftest
tools.description: Run the compiled correctness suite (all wheel widths x both queue modes plus known pi(n)). Call this before any measurement job; it returns ok=false and a detail line when the build is stale or wrong.

tools.name: sieve_count
tools.description: Count primes <= limit with the segmented sieve and report measured time, segment count and bit-clear count. All values come from the real bench binary.

limit.description: Upper bound n; 1e10 is the practical ceiling (~21 s).

bucket.description: Use the cross-segment queue for far primes.

reps.description: Repetitions; the minimum time is reported.

tools.name: sieve_autotune
tools.description: Run a two-stage parameter search (coarse screen over wheel x bucket x segment at 1e7, then validate the top candidates at the target limit) and return the ranked measurements plus the winning configuration.

budget_seconds.description: Wall-clock budget for the whole search.
